name: Haolin He
tagline: Learning to hear, see, and interact.
intro: I'm a Ph.D. student at [The Chinese University of Hong Kong](https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/), advised by [Prof. Qiuqiang Kong](https://qiuqiangkong.github.io/), and a research intern with the **Qwen team at Alibaba**.
I work on multimodal understanding and interaction, aiming to build AI assistants that integrate deeply into people's everyday lives.

publications.name: OmniVChat
publications.title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
publications.authors: **H. He**, Y. Chu, Q. Chen, W. Huang, Y. Feng, M. Zhu, Z. Dai, …, X. Chen, J. Xu, Q. Kong
publications.description: From synthetic conversations to better interaction: a data engine, benchmark, and post-training recipe for native audio–visual dialogue.
highlights: **OmniVChat-Studio:** a four-agent data engine that synthesizes single- and multi-turn multimodal dialogues from a text corpus and subcategory configurations, with rendered clips, reference replies, and tiered rubrics.

**OmniVChat-Bench:** 2,800 synthesized dialogues spanning five ability categories, 17 subcategories, and 22 scenario domains; evaluates basic dialogue abilities in eleven released systems with explicit rubric criteria.

**OmniVChat-RL:** training Qwen3-Omni-Instruct on 5,600 synthetic dialogues raises rubric scores from **0.465 to 0.652** on OmniVChat-Bench and **0.402 to 0.632** on the human-recorded OmniVChat-Bench-Human. Mean reply length falls from **79 to 36 words**, while Style increases from **0.710 to 0.992**.

publications.name: Omni Demand Understanding
publications.title: Omni Demand Understanding: A Benchmark for Contextual User-Intent Inference in Multimodal Interaction
publications.authors: Q. Chen, Y. Chu, **H. He**, Y. Yang, Z. Liu, Y. Wang, Z. Ma, …, Q. Kong, J. Xu, X. Chen
publications.description: Understanding what a person needs from what they say, what they show, and the context around them.
highlights: Developed **ODU-Bench**, with 2,078 synthetic and human-recorded scenes for demand detection and contextual intent inference, evaluated across five dimensions.
Evaluated 14 native multimodal models: Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers **44.7%** of context-dependent key information, while **11 of 14** models falsely trigger on more than half of no-demand scenes.

publications.name: AudioMCQ
publications.title: Measuring Audio's Impact on Correctness: Audio-Contribution-Aware Post-Training of Large Audio Language Models
publications.authors: **H. He**, X. Du, R. Sun, Z. Dai, Y. Xiao, M. Yang, J. Zhou, …, M. Plumbley, J. Liu, Q. Kong
publications.description: Helping audio models actually listen: measuring audio's contribution and reducing shortcuts in multimodal reasoning.
highlights: Released **AudioMCQ**, containing 571k multiple-choice questions with structured and unstructured chain-of-thought supervision for grounded reasoning across sound, speech, and music.

Developed **AudioMCQ-StrongAC-GeminiCoT**, a **19,480-sample** subset with Gemini reasoning summaries for temporal analysis and evidence-based option selection, supporting CoT distillation; adopted as the official DCASE 2026 Task 5 training set.

Proposed **Audio-Contribution Filtering** and Weak-to-Strong / Mixed-to-Strong post-training to reduce text-only shortcuts; reached **78.2%** on MMAU-test-mini, **75.6%** on MMAU, and **67.1%** on MMAR — state of the art at publication.
